title: Afterempire: colonial holdings, trade flows and inherited development systems, 1800–2025
description:
Afterempire is a time-indexed atlas of the British, French, Portuguese and Dutch empires from 1800 to 2025, with the code and data behind its website.

  • Holdings gazetteer: 177 colonial holdings and 638 control periods (colonies, protectorates, mandates, company rule, occupations), cross-checked against COLDAT.
  • Trade flows: bilateral trade touching each holding, 1800–2020, harmonised from RICardo, CEPII TRADHIST and CEPII Gravity, with each holding's share of trade with its (former) metropole.
  • Development systems: planning regime, planning institution and monetary arrangement by decade for 21 former colonies, with qualitative lineages; UN voting alignment for 94 ex-colonies; similarity scores against coloniser, Soviet and US/Bretton Woods reference models.

Version 0.1.0. The development codings are drafts that have not yet been reviewed; their review status is recorded row by row in data/curated/systems_codings.csv. Website: https://dia-quant.github.io/afterempire/
